name: Ventilation fan automatic changeover
summary: Transfers the documented ventilation duty when the active fan becomes unavailable.
description: Transfers the documented ventilation duty when the active fan becomes unavailable. Ventilation control coordinates the equipment that manages heat and air movement in an electrical room. A temperature request, a fan command and proof of airflow are separate signals, and the room design determines how they interact.

In a switchroom containing transformers and auxiliary panels, the room controller can supervise fan availability and send an alarm when the documented ventilation duty is not achieved. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Duty-fan fault” at the input and “Standby-fan request” at the output. Changeover conditions require the ventilation design.
